8500.meaning1: not frequently paying attention to; not regularly bringing-to-mind; not focusing on a lot

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'anāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

8501.meaning1: due to lack of attention; because of loss of focus

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, anuruddhā, etadahosi, amanasikāro kho me udapādi, amanasikār'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

8502.synonym: akanta, akantiya, aniṭṭha, appiya, amanāpika, amanāpiya, nanikāma, paṭikūla, paṭikkūla, lūkhasa
8502.commentary: (SNa) na tāsu mano appeti, na tā manaṃ appāyanti vaḍḍhentī'ti amanāpā.

examples.text: duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tippānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti
pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca

8503.grammar: fem, abstr, from na manāpa, neg
8503.construction:
na > a + manāpa + tā
amanāpa + tā

examples.text: tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa sahadassanena amanāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, pāṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jegucchatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jighacchitānam'pi na bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva suhitānaṃ.

8504.meaning1: unlikeable in nature; of disagreeable character
8504.commentary: (VINt) paraṃ vā amanāparūpan'ti ettha amanāpaṃ rūpaṃ etassā'ti amanāparūpo'ti bāhir'atthasamāso daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti iṭṭharūpaṃ'y'eva vijānāti, no aniṭṭharūpaṃ, kantarūpaṃ'y'eva vijānāti, no akantarūpaṃ, manāparūpaṃ'y'eva vijānāti, no amanāparūpaṃ. lābhā vo, bhikkhave, suladdhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, khaṇo vo paṭiladdho brahmacariyavāsāyā'ti.

8505.meaning1: association with the unpleasant; meeting with the disagreeable

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yaṃ vā vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakan'ti?

8506.construction:
na > a + manāpa + ika
amanāpa + ika
8506.synonym: akanta, akantiya, aniṭṭha, appiya, amanāpa, nanikāma, paṭikūla, paṭikkūla, lūkhasa

8507.synonym: akanta, akantiya, aniṭṭha, appiya, amanāpa, nanikāma, paṭikūla, paṭikkūla, lūkhasa

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti

8508.grammar: ind, adv, from instr sg of na manāpa, neg
8508.construction:
na > a + manāpa + ena
amanāpa + ena

examples.text: api ca me, āvuso, satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. etañ'hi, āvuso, sāvakassa patirūpaṃ yaṃ satthāraṃ paricareyya manāpen'eva, no amanāpena. anupavajjaṃ channo bhikkhu satthaṃ āharissatī'ti, evam'etaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, dhārehī'ti.
manussānaṃ piyo hoti, amanussānaṃ piyo hoti, devatā rakkhanti, n'āssa aggi vā visaṃ vā satthaṃ vā kamati, tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettācetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.

8510.commentary: (VINa) amanusso nāma yo sabbaso vā manussānaṃ abhāvena yakkhapariggahabhūto, yato vā manussā kenaci kāraṇena puna'pi āgantu'kāmā eva apakkantā.

examples.text: gāmo nāma ekakuṭiko'pi gāmo, dvikuṭiko'pi gāmo, tikuṭiko'pi gāmo, catukuṭiko'pi gāmo, samanusso'pi gāmo, amanusso'pi gāmo, parikkhitto'pi gāmo, aparikkhitto'pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho'pi gāmo, yo'pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so'pi vuccati gāmo.

8511.meaning1: capture by non-human beings; possession by spirits
8511.commentary: (SNa) na amanussaggāho gahessatī'ti mahaggho ayaṃ candanasāro, vimānadvāre naṃ ṭhapessāmā'ti maññamānā na amanussā gaṇhissanti.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sace tumhe'pi… na amanussaggāho gahessati, na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūtī bhavissatha, evaṃ tumhe, bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.

8512.meaning1: uninhabited place; (comm) (or) place inhabited by non-humans
8512.commentary: (VVa) amanussaṭṭhāne'ti amanussānaṃ pisāc'ādīnaṃ sañcaraṇaṭṭhāne, manussānaṃ vā agocaraṭṭhāne.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, amanussaṭṭhāne pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sīt'odakā sāt'odakā set'odakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā. taṃ jano n'eva hareyya na piveyya na nahāyeyya na yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya.
vaṅke araññe amanussaṭṭhāne, kantāre app'odake appabhakkhe, suduggame vaṇṇ'upathassa majjhe, vaṅkaṃ bhayā naṭṭhamanā manussā.

8513.commentary: (VINa) paṇḍakā'ti ussannakilesā avūpasantapariḷāhā napuṃsakā, te pariḷāhaveg'ābhibhūtā yena kenaci saddhiṃ mittabhāvaṃ patthenti.

8514.commentary: (VISMa) amanussapurisā'ti ettha na manussā'ti amanussā. taṃsadisatā ettha jotīyati, tena manussattamattaṃ n'atthi, aññaṃ samānan'ti yakkh'ādayo amanussā'ti adhippetā, na ye keci manussehi aññe. tathā hi tiracchānapurisānaṃ visuṃ gahaṇaṃ kataṃ, yakkh'ādayo eva ca niddiṭṭhā.

examples.text: idaṃ sattamaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, vessavaṇassa mahārājassa sahabyataṃ upapajjāmi, so tato cuto manussarājā, amanussarājā divi homi.

8516.meaning1: not touched by humans; unseen by people; (comm) lived in by goblins
8516.commentary: (THIa) yathā taṃ amanussasevitan'ti tañ'ca rakkhasapariggahitāya pokkharaṇiyā jātattā nimmanussehi sevitaṃ kenaci aparibhuttam'eva bhaveyya.

examples.text: uppalaṃ c'udakā samuggataṃ, yathā taṃ amanussasevitaṃ, evaṃ tvaṃ brahmacārinī, sakes'aṅgesu jaraṃ gamissasi.

8517.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: nam'atthi ūnaṃ kāmehi, hiṃsitā me na vijjati, amanussavaco sutvā, tasm'āhaṃ na gahe rame.

8518.meaning1: sight of the deities; seeing non-human beings

examples.text: tesaṃ pāturahu ñāṇaṃ, amanussāna'dassanaṃ, app'eke satam'addakkhuṃ, sahassaṃ atha sattariṃ.

8519.meaning2: caused by a non-human, by a demon

8523.commentary: (VINa) ubhatobyañjanā'ti itthinimittena ca purisanimittena cā'ti ubhohi byañjanehi samannāgatā.

examples.text: tisso itthiyo, manuss'itthī, amanussitthī, tiracchānagatitthī. tayo ubhatobyañjanakā, manuss'ubhatobyañjanako, amanuss'ubhatobyañjanako, tiracchānagatubhatobyañjanako. tayo paṇḍakā, manussapaṇḍako, amanussapaṇḍako, tiracchānagatapaṇḍako.
disvāna rūpāni manoramāni, atho'pi disvāna amanoramāni, manorame rāgapathaṃ vinodaye, na c'āppiyaṃ me'ti manaṃ padosaye.

8525.meaning2: not a mantra; not a sacred scripture

examples.text: att'upanāyikan'ti attani upanetabbaṃ. samphabhāsenā'ti amantabhāsena. samphappalāpabhāsenā'ti samphappalāpasambhāsena niratthakena aññāṇavacanenā'ti attho.

8526.meaning1: free from 'mine'; not selfish; without attachment
8526.commentary: (DNa) amamā'ti vatth'ābharaṇa-pānabhojan'ādīsu'pi mamattavirahitā. (UDa) anokasārī amamo nirāso'ti tathā sabbadhi vippamuttattā eva okasaṅkhātesu chasu'pi āyatanesu taṇh'ābhisaraṇassa abhāvena anokasārī, rūp'ādīsu katthaci mamaṅ'kār'ābhāvato amamo, sabbena sabbaṃ anāsīsanato nirāso. (SNPa) amamo ca subbato, puttadāresu taṇhādiṭṭhimamattavirahito sucivatattā sundaravatattā ca subbato so khīṇ'āsavabhikkhu.

examples.text: mamāyite passatha phandamāne, macche'va app'odake khīṇasote, etam'pi disvā amamo careyya, bhavesu āsattim'akubbamāno.
yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.

8527.commentary: (DNa) na maratī'ti amarā. kā sā? evan'ti'pi me no'ti-ādinā nayena pariyantarahitā diṭṭhigatikassa diṭṭhi c'eva vācā ca. vividho khepo'ti vikkhepo, amarāya diṭṭhiyā vācāya ca vikkhepo'ti amarāvikkhepo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti amarāvikkhepikā

examples.text: tatra, sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā mando momūho. so mandattā momūhattā tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ, evan'ti'pi me no, tathā'ti'pi me no, aññathā'ti'pi me no, no'ti'pi me no, no no'ti'pi me no'ti.

8528.meaning1: undying; not subject to death; immortal
8528.meaning2: undying; not subject to death; immortal
8528.commentary: (MNa) aho vatā no'ti aho vata nu, ayam'eva vā pāṭho. amarā'ti c'āhū'ti amaraṃ iti ca āhu. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yaṃ mataṃ ñātī parivāretvā kandanti, taṃ, aho vata amhākaṃ bhātā mato, putto mato'ti-ādīni'pi vadanti. (THa) aho vatā no amarā'ti c'āhū'ti aho vata amhākaṃ ñātī amarā siyun'ti ca kathenti, gāthāsukh'atthañ'h'ettha vatā-iti dīghaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, ahovatā no amarā'ti c'āhu, vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samādhāya tatoḍahanti.
amarāvitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ par'ānudayatā-paṭisaṃyutta-vitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ lābha-sakkāra-siloka-paṭisaṃyutta-vitakkavaḍḍhanaṃ

8530.grammar: nt, act, from na marati, neg

examples.text: ubhayena m'idaṃ maraṇam'eva, na-amaraṇaṃ pacchā vā pure vā, paṭipajjatha mā vinassatha, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā.

8531.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

8532.commentary: (DNa) aparo nayo, amarā nāma ekā macchajāti, sā ummujjana-nimujjan'ādi-vasena udake sandhāvamānā gahetuṃ na sakkā'ti, evam'eva ayam'pi vādo itoc'ito ca sandhāvati, gāhaṃ na upagacchatī'ti amarāvikkhepo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tatra, sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā mando momūho. so mandattā momūhattā tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ, evan'ti'pi me no, tathā'ti'pi me no, aññathā'ti'pi me no, no'ti'pi me no, no no'ti'pi me no'ti.

8534.meaning1: endless equivocation; (or) wriggling like an eel; inability to be pinned down to a viewpoint
8534.commentary: (DNa) na maratī'ti amarā. kā sā? evan'ti'pi me no'ti-ādinā nayena pariyantarahitā diṭṭhigatikassa diṭṭhi c'eva vācā ca. vividho khepo'ti vikkhepo, amarāya diṭṭhiyā vācāya ca vikkhepo'ti amarāvikkhepo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti amarāvikkhepikā, aparo nayo, amarā nāma ekā macchajāti, sā ummujjana-nimujjan'ādi-vasena udake sandhāvamānā gahetuṃ na sakkā'ti, evam'eva ayam'pi vādo itoc'ito ca sandhāvati, gāhaṃ na upagacchatī'ti amarāvikkhepo'ti vuccati. so etesaṃ atthī'ti amarāvikkhepikā.

examples.text: tatra, sandaka, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā mando momūho. so mandattā momūhattā tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjati amarāvikkhepaṃ, evan'ti'pi me no, tathā'ti'pi me no, aññathā'ti'pi me no, no'ti'pi me no, no no'ti'pi me no'ti.

8535.meaning2: doctrine of eel wriggling; doctrine of equivocation

examples.text: etena ekaccasassatavādā satta saññīvādā ca dassitā. n'eva hoti na na hotī'ti iminā pana amarāvikkhepavādo dassito'ti veditabbaṃ.

8536.meaning1: who equivocates endlessly; (or) who wriggles like an eel; who cannot be pinned down to a viewpoint
8536.commentary: (DNa) vividho khepo'ti vikkhepo, amarāya diṭṭhiyā vācāya ca vikkhepo'ti amarāvikkhepo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti amarāvikkhepikā, aparo nayo, amarā nāma ekā macchajāti, sā ummujjana-nimujjan'ādi-vasena udake sandhāvamānā gahetuṃ na sakkā'ti, evam'eva ayam'pi vādo itoc'ito ca sandhāvati, gāhaṃ na upagacchatī'ti amarāvikkhepo'ti vuccati. so etesaṃ atthī'ti amarāvikkhepikā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā amarāvikkhepikā, tattha tattha pañhaṃ puṭṭhā samānā vācāvikkhepaṃ āpajjanti amarāvikkhepaṃ catūhi vatthūhi.
atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo

8540.meaning1: without impurity; free from dirt; stainless; spotless; unblemished
8540.construction:
na > a + √mal + a + ina
amala + ina

8542.meaning1: narrow; not enlarged; not exalted; unexpansive; not impressive

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ… mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittan'ti pajāneyyaṃ, amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittan'ti pajāneyyaṃ

8543.meaning1: state of not eating a lot

8544.meaning1: not big; not great; not large; not grand; not vast; not extensive

8546.meaning1: which (part) mother and son; (comm) unable to protect mother and son
8546.construction:
na > a + mātar + putta + ika
amātāputta + ika
8546.commentary: (ANa) amātāputtikānī'ti mātā ca putto ca mātāputtaṃ, parittātuṃ samatthabhāvena n'atthi ettha mātāputtan'ti amātāputtikāni.

examples.text: gāmesupi ḍayhamānesu nigamesupi ḍayhamānesu nagaresupi ḍayhamānesu tattha mātā'pi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, putto'pi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayan'ti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.

8547.meaning1: not a woman; not a female
8547.notes: Masculine in grammar, feminine in meaning.

examples.text: amātugāme vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amātugāme amātugāmasaññī, anāpatti.
mātugāme amātugāmasaññī sahaseyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

8549.grammar: pp of na māneti, neg, caus
8549.meaning1: not respected; not honoured; not revered; not highly regarded

examples.text: aññatitthiyā pana paribbājakā asakkatā honti agarukatā amānitā apūjitā anapacitā, na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānaṃ.
suññ'āgāraṃ paviṭṭhassa, santacittassa bhikkhuno, amānusī rati hoti, sammā dhammaṃ vipassato.

8552.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of na mānusa, neg
8552.construction:
na > a + manu > mānu + *sa + ī
amānusa + ī

examples.text: suññ'āgāraṃ paviṭṭhassa, santacittassa bhikkhuno, amānusī rati hoti, sammā dhammaṃ vipassato.
sacco siyā appagabbho, amāyo rittapesuṇo, akkodhano lobhapāpaṃ, vevicchaṃ vitare muni.

8556.grammar: fem, abstr, from na māyā, neg

examples.text: maccharissa purisapuggalassa amacchariyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, saṭhassa purisapuggalassa asāṭheyyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, māyāvissa purisapuggalassa amāyā hoti parikkamanāya
māyāvissa purisapuggalassa amāyā hoti parinibbānāya. thaddhassa purisapuggalassa atthaddhiyaṃ hoti parinibbānāya.

8557.grammar: fem, abstr, from na māyāvī, neg
8557.construction:
na > a + māyā + vī + tā
amāyāvī + tā

examples.text: saṭhassa purisapuggalassa asāṭheyyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, māyāvissa purisapuggalassa amāyāvitā hoti parikkamanāya, thaddhassa purisapuggalassa atthaddhiyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya

8558.meaning1: not deceitful; not hypocritical; not fraudulent

examples.text: ye pana te kulaputtā saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā asaṭhā amāyāvino aketabino anuddhatā anunnaḷā acapalā amukharā avikiṇṇavācā… tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
etu viññū puriso asaṭho amāyāvī ujujātiko, aham'anusāsāmi ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.

8559.meaning1: what is not Māra's realm; what is beyond death's domain; what is outside the power of death

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā akusalā imassa lokassa akusalā parassa lokassa, akusalā māradheyyassa akusalā amāradheyyassa, akusalā maccudheyyassa akusalā amaccudheyyassa, tesaṃ ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde, gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme, ādittato'haṃ samathehi yutto, paññāya dacchaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
kadā nu kaṭṭhe ca tiṇe latā ca, khandhe ime'haṃ amite ca dhamme, ajjhattikān'eva ca bāhirāni ca, samaṃ tuleyyaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

8562.meaning2: of infinite radiance; of boundless lustre

examples.text: caranti bālā dummedhā, amitten'eva attanā, karontā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, yaṃ hoti kaṭukapphalaṃ.
bālasaṅgatacārī hi, dīgham'addhāna socati, dukkho bālehi saṃvāso, amitten'eva sabbadā, dhīro ca sukhasaṃvāso, ñātīnaṃ'va samāgamo.

8564.commentary: (DNa) amittatāpanā'ti amittānaṃ patāpanā. (DNt) amittatāpanā'ti amittānaṃ tapanasīlā, amittatāpanaṃ hotu vā mā vā evaṃsabhāvā'ti attho. na hi cakkavattino puttānaṃ amittā nāma keci honti, ye te bhaveyyuṃ, cakk'ānubhāveneva sabbe'pi khattiy'ādayo anuvattakā tesaṃ bhavanti.

examples.text: pahūtaputto bhavatī tathāvidho, parosahassañ'ca bhavanti atrajā, sūrā ca vīrā ca amittatāpanā, gihissa pītiṃjananā piyaṃvadā.

8565.grammar: masc, abl sg of amitta, neg
8565.construction:
na > a + √mitt + a + to
amitta + to
8565.commentary: (MNa) amittato'pi daheyyā'ti amitto me ayan'ti evaṃ amittato ṭhapeyya. dutiyapade'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tañ'ca naṃ purisaṃ amittato'pi daheyya, paccatthikato'pi daheyya, api ca jīvitā voropetabbaṃ maññeyya, dīgharattaṃ vata, bho, ahaṃ iminā purisena telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena nikato vañcito paluddho, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti.

8566.commentary: (MNa) tadaminā'pī'ti taṃ tumhe iminā'pi kāraṇena jānāthā'ti atthañ'ca byañjanañ'ca samānetvā ath'assa ca aññathā gahitabhāvo byañjanassa ca micchā ropitabhāvo dassetabbo.

examples.text: tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathāme'daṃ nidassanaṃ, caṇḍālaputto sopāko, mātaṅgo iti vissuto.
tadaminā'p'etaṃ, mahārāja, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ghoso'y'ev'eso lokasmiṃ, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo… brahmadāy'ādā'ti.
